name: File history
description: Every text file's earlier versions, like a shared document's: who changed it (you, an agent, another device) and when, what each version changed, marked in the note, and Restore this version. Kept on this machine, not in the vault: a version each time a file rests a minute between changes, at most one every few minutes while it keeps changing, and one before and after each agent's edit. Open it from a file's menu, or from the line at the top of a file an agent changed.

header.label: Agents' edits in files' headers
header.description: a line saying who and when; atop a file an agent changed last, in the past day, opening its version history

interval_min.label: Minutes between versions
interval_min.description: while a file keeps changing; at most one version of it in this many minutes

keep_days.label: Days to keep versions
keep_days.description: earlier versions, kept on this machine
